New Zealand vs India Live Score, 2nd ODI: Shubman Gill drops Daryl Mitchell; NZ 47/3 (17) vs IND
 NZ vs IND: Follow live score and updates from the India vs New Zealand 2nd ODI being played at the Hnry Stadium in Wellington.

 AFP
 W elcome to Sportstar’s live coverage of the second ODI between New Zealand and India being played at the Hnry Stadium in Wellington. 
 November 07, 2026 09:58 
 NZ 48/3 in 18 overs
 Gurnoor for his fourth over. Another splendid over by the fast bowler. Mitchell in no mood to take risks now after he was dropped last over. 
 November 07, 2026 09:53 
 NZ 47/3 in 17 overs
 Kamboj continues. DROPPED! Shubman Gill has dropped a regular, easy catch of Mitchell. He went for the pull, ended up skying the ball. Gill came underneath the ball but the ball pop out of his hands. Just two runs from the over. 
 November 07, 2026 09:50 
 NZ 45/3 in 16 overs
 This has been an excellent display of fast bowling by the Indians. Latham and Mitchell might have to start taking risks now to put runs on the board. 22 balls since the last boundary. Runs not coming easily at all. 
 November 07, 2026 09:45 
 NZ 44/3 in 15 overs
 Kamboj continues after drinks break. Not much change in the plan though, continues to target the off stump. 
 November 07, 2026 09:37 
 NZ 43/3 in 14 overs
 Gurnoor continues. A good start for Gurnoor as well. Isn’t getting a lot of movement but has been working in and around the off stump, not allowing much freedom to both batters. 
 November 07, 2026 09:31 4 
 NZ 41/3 in 13 overs
 Kamboj continues. Mitchell looking to free his arms now a bit. Kamboj bowls a touch fuller outside off and Mitchell slaps it past the mid on fielder for four. Another full delivery and Mitchell this time goes left of the mid on fielder for another boundary. 
 November 07, 2026 09:28 
 NZ 33/3 in 12 overs
 Gurnoor Brar is into the attack now. Despite bowling a wide off the first ball, he has begun his spell tightly as well, giving just three runs in the over. Bowling much shorter than others. 
 November 07, 2026 09:26 
 NZ 30/3 in 11 overs
 Kamboj continues his tidy lines. Tom Latham and Daryl Mitchell looking to revive the innings and waiting for Indian bowlers to make mistakes. So far, they haven’t got a lot of those opportunities. 
 November 07, 2026 09:17 6 
 NZ 29/3 in 10 overs
 Nabi continues with keeper Rahul up at the stumps. Mitchell picks the good length early and launches the ball over long on for a six! Counterattack? Nabi comes back well in that over, just six off it. 
 November 07, 2026 09:16 
 NZ 23/3 in 9 overs
 Anshul Kamboj into the attack. He comes around the wicket to Nicholls. OUT! Nicholls chops onto the stumps! Third wicket down for New Zealand. Nicholls tried defending the angling in delivery, but the ball rolled onto the stumps. 
 November 07, 2026 09:13 
 A disciplined first spell between Nabi and Arshdeep
 pitchmap-(CricViz)-2026-11-7-9-12-38.png
 November 07, 2026 09:05 
 NZ 19/2 in 8 overs
 Now Nabi comes around the wicket against left-handed Henry Nicholls. The movement has gone down quite a bit. Indian bowlers are now looking to challenge the stumps more. 
 Nabi bowls a no ball. On free hit, he ends up bowling a wide. Short ball, Nicholls goes for the pull and misses out on the free hit! 
 Four! Mitchell gets a streaky boundary to end the over. Went for the slog, got an outside edge towards deep third. 
 November 07, 2026 09:03 
 NZ 12/2 in 7 overs
 Arshdeep comes around the wicket for Mitchell. He defends the first ball. Just a single off that over. 
 November 07, 2026 08:56 W 
 NZ 11/2 in 6 overs
 Nabi continues. Slightler fuller on the pads and Young flicks it away behind square leg for four. First boundary of the day. OUT! Nabi corrects his line, pitches the ball slightly shorter than previous and Young gets an outside edge; KL Rahul takes a brilliant one-handed catch, diving towards his right. 
 Daryl Mitchell defends his first ball. 
 November 07, 2026 08:54 
 NZ 7/1 in 5 overs
 Despite Nabi taking that wicket, Arshdeep has been more threatening and impressive in the first couple of overs. He is bowling at a good pace and getting the ball to move both sides. Just as I write, there’s a huge LBW appeal against Nicholls but umpire says it’s not out. 
 November 07, 2026 08:52 
 NZ 6/1 in 4 overs
 A very tidy start from both the bowlers. Nabi is getting the ball to move away from the left hander as well. So both edges of the bat are in play at the moment. 
 November 07, 2026 08:43 
 NZ 4/1 in 3 overs
 Arshdeep. Young is off the mark as well working the ball towards leg side for a single. Another good over by Arshdeep, just two runs coming off it. 
 November 07, 2026 08:36 W 
 NZ 2/1 in 2 overs
 Auqib Nabi from the other end. A hint of movement for Nabi as well. A touch shorter and wider from Nabi. OUT! This time Nabi bowls into the stumps on length and Seifert ends up chipping straight to mid on. The ball might have stuck on the pitch as Seifert completely mistimed that shot. 
 Henry Nicholls gets himself and New Zealand off the mark with a double towards square leg. 
 November 07, 2026 08:32 
 NZ 0/0 in 1 over
 Arshdeep Singh with the new ball. A hint of movement inside the right-handed Will Young, who defends it. And this time the ball moves the other way and almost took the outside edge of Young! He was taken by surprise there. Arshdeep right on the money, bowling just around the off stump line on good length. Young playing late to negate the movement and play right underneath his eyes. A maiden over to start. 
 November 07, 2026 08:30 
 All set 
 The players are out in the middle. India in a huddle while New Zealand openers -- Will Young and Tim Seifert -- take guards. 
 November 07, 2026 08:18 
 A 47-over per side game
 After rain delayed start in Wellington by an hour, the match will now be played for 47 overs per side. A total of six overs lost out of 100. 
 10 overs of 1st PowerPlay as usual. A maximum of two bowlers can bowl 10 overs, rest nine overs. PP 2 between 11-38 overs. 
 November 07, 2026 08:08 
 Playing XIs
 India: Rohit Sharma, Shubman Gill(c), Virat Kohli, Shreyas Iyer, KL Rahul(w), Axar Patel, Naman Dhir, Anshul Kamboj, Auqib Nabi, Gurnoor Brar, Arshdeep Singh
 New Zealand: Will Young, Tim Seifert, Henry Nicholls, Daryl Mitchell, Tom Latham(w), Glenn Phillips, Mitchell Santner(c), Nathan Smith, Kyle Jamieson, Jacob Duffy, Blair Tickner
 November 07, 2026 08:06 
 Toss
 India wins the toss and opts to bowl. 
 Shubman Gill confirms no changes in India’s playing XI. Mitchell Santner, too, is playing the same team. 
 November 07, 2026 07:46 
 POSITIVE NEWS: Toss at 8 AM IST, Match start 8:30 AM IST
 The ground has been inspected. We will have the toss at 8 AM IST. No news yet on whether we’ve lost overs due to the interruption. 
 November 07, 2026 07:39 
 A champion with the ball, and a bhai who never forgot where he came from.
 While we wait, here is Shayan Acharya’s tribute to Shami, the Test bowler and friend. 
 Mohammed Shami: Beyond the magic with the ball, the memories that remain
 Mohammed Shami: a legendary fast bowler whose on-field mastery matched his unforgettable friendships and humble, heartfelt journeys.
 November 07, 2026 07:26 
 The next inspection is at 7:45AM IST
 Umpires are out about checking conditions out, but the next inspection is in 20 minutes from now. Watch this space for updates as they happen. 
 November 07, 2026 07:08 
 The toss is delayed due to a wet outfield
 We should have had the toss, but the rain had delayed that. There was a pause in the rain and the groundstaff got back to work trying to get the playing field ready., but it looks like there is a sprinkle of rain again. 
 November 07, 2026 06:53 
 Weather update
 The rain has stopped in Wellington. Depending on how much the excess water, we might soon have the toss time details as well! 
 November 07, 2026 06:49 
 Squads
 India: Rohit Sharma, Shubman Gill(c), Virat Kohli, Shreyas Iyer, Axar Patel, KL Rahul(w), Naman Dhir, Anshul Kamboj, Auqib Nabi, Gurnoor Brar, Arshdeep Singh, Ruturaj Gaikwad, Mohammed Siraj, Ishan Kishan, Kuldeep Yadav
 New Zealand: Will Young, Tim Seifert, Henry Nicholls, Daryl Mitchell, Tom Latham(w), Glenn Phillips, Mitchell Santner(c), Nathan Smith, Kyle Jamieson, Jacob Duffy, Blair Tickner, Nick Kelly, Matthew Fisher, Michael Bracewell, Matt Henry
 November 07, 2026 06:32 
 Weather
 It is currently raining in Wellington which could hamper the start of the game. The toss was scheduled at 7 am IST while the first ball was scheduled at 7:30 am IST. 
 November 07, 2026 06:26 
 Welcome
 Welcome to the live coverage of the second ODI between India and New Zealand at the Hnry Stadium in Wellington. Stay tuned for the live updates.
